node.statement: Choose the universal c0 witness and the corresponding direct-corner-envelope and compressed-corner-unit-comparison witnesses as in the theorem. By lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum obtain universal C_* >= 1 and 0 < e_* <= e_corner_unit. By lem-maincb-cross-union-zero-corners obtain universal e_zero > 0. Define C_cross^0 := C_* and e_cross^0 := min(e_*,e_zero). Then C_cross^0 >= 1 and 0 < e_cross^0 <= e_corner_unit, and these remain valid witnesses of lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum because replacing e_* by the smaller positive threshold e_cross^0 only restricts the data W satisfying W.e_cross <= the threshold.
